name: PowPop
description: Discover people, posts and places around you on PowPop.
description_zh: 发现附近的数字人、真实用户与帖子，按关键词搜索话题，浏览景点商圈、打卡活动与会员方案。
description_en: Discover nearby digital humans, users and posts on PowPop; search topics by keyword; browse attractions, campaigns and membership plans.
examples_zh: 看看我附近有什么有意思的人
附近有哪些景点和商圈？
现在有什么活动可以参加？
examples_en: Search posts about the Forbidden City
What attractions and districts are near me?
What campaigns can I join right now?
How much does a membership cost?
